# Hi, I'm Zhenghong!

Welcome to my personal website!

## About Me

I'm currently a master's student in Biostatistics at Columbia University, focusing on Public Health Data Science.

Before coming to Columbia, I studied Mathematics and Applied Mathematics at the University of Nottingham.

I'm interested in statistics, data science, and machine learning. I enjoy working with data and learning how to use different tools to solve problems.

## My Interests

Some of the areas I'm interested in are:

- Data Science
- Machine Learning
- Statistics
- Data Visualization

## What I've Worked On

During my undergraduate studies, I worked on several projects involving mathematical modelling and data analysis.

Some of my projects include studying gene regulatory networks, analyzing ESG ratings and corporate bonds, and modelling the motion of amusement rides.

I've also had some experience working with financial data during an internship.

## About This Website

I created this website as part of my Data Science course at Columbia.

Here, I'll share a little about my academic background, experience, and some of the projects I've worked on.
